title: Writing
statusNote: PRD Section 23.1 item 2 states the final free-writing task prompt has not been written. This is a development task of the same shape as the approved one (a single open-ended free-writing task, FR-WRITE-001/002) and must be replaced with the team's approved prompt before the pilot.
instructions: Write your answer in English. There is no time limit, and you may plan your ideas before you begin.

task.prompt: Some students believe that university courses should focus only on subjects directly related to their future job. Others believe students should also study a wider range of subjects. Write an essay giving your opinion on this issue. Support your view with reasons and examples from your own experience.
task.guidance: Write in clear paragraphs. State your position, give reasons for it, and support each reason with an example. Aim for a well-organised answer of roughly 200 to 250 words; there is no penalty for writing more or less than this.
